text: Senior Citizen Rate Advantage: Senior citizen depositors aged 60 years and above are entitled to an additional interest rate of **0.50% p.a.** across all deposit tenures.
section: Section 2: Premature Liquidation and Penalties Premature Withdrawal Permitted: Customers may break or liquidate their Fixed Deposit at any time through the FinBase App. Premature Penalty: A penalty of **1.00%** is deducted from the contracted interest rate applicable for the period the FD actually remained open. 7-Day Minimum Holding Rule: If a Fixed Deposit is closed prematurely within 7 days from the booking date, **zero interest** is payable under RBI regulations. Section 3: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) & Form 15G / 15H TDS Threshold: TDS is deducted at 10% if the total annual interest income across all deposits exceeds ₹40,000 in a financial year (₹50,000 for senior citizens). Non-PAN Penalty: If a valid PAN is not linked to the customer account, TDS is statutorily deducted at 20%. Zero TDS Exemption (Form 15G/15H): Depositors whose estimated total annual income is below the taxable threshold may submit Form 15G (for individuals below 60 years) or Form 15H (for senior citizens aged 60+) digitally via the FinBase App to avoid TDS deduction. Section 4: FinBase Wealth — Mutual Funds & SIP Direct Mutual Funds: FinBase Wealth provides access to over 1,500+ Direct Mutual Fund schemes with **0% distributor commission**. Minimum Systematic Investment Plan (SIP): Start investing with as low as **₹100 per month**. Redemption Turnaround: Redemption proceeds are credited directly to your FinBase Savings Account within T+1 to T+3 business days depending on scheme category. Section 5: FinBase Wealth — 24K Digital Gold and Silver Purity & Storage: 24 Karat 99.9% pure digital gold backed by physical bullion stored in secure, insured vaults managed by MMTC-PAMP. Minimum Purchase: Customers can buy digital gold starting from as low as **₹10**. Physical Delivery: Digital gold balances can be redeemed into physical minted gold coins/bars starting at 1 gram, delivered securely to the customer's doorstep. Section 6: Wealth Portfolio Risk & Asset Management Standards 6 Standard FB-WLTH-006 details customer risk profiling, asset allocation rebalancing, and SEBI compliance guidelines. All investment recommendations are generated through algorithmically determined risk suitability scores. Guideline 6.1: Systematic withdrawal plan (SWP) execution calendars. Guideline 6.2: Capital gains statement generation for financial year-end tax filing. Guideline 6.3: Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) secondary market redemption protocols. Guideline 6.4: Liquid fund instant redemption limit up to ₹50,000 per day. Guideline 6.5: SEBI mandated risk-o-meter disclosures for high-volatility thematic funds. Guideline 6.6: Asset management custody reconciliation with clearing corporations. Guideline 6.7: Digital signature verification for high-net-worth portfolio mandates. section: Section 22: Explicit Product Exclusions & Unsupported Services Policy To prevent customer confusion and combat financial scams, FinBase explicitly defines services that are strictly NOT offered or supported on its platform: Cryptocurrency & Virtual Digital Assets: FinBase does **NOT** provide cryptocurrency trading, Bitcoin/Ethereum wallets, or virtual digital asset exchange facilities. Agricultural Property Loans: FinBase does **NOT** offer loans against agricultural farmland or rural mortgage loans. Speculative Intraday Tips: FinBase does **NOT** provide daily stock market intraday calls, F&O options tips, or speculative trading advice. Unregulated Chit Funds / Ponzi Schemes: Strictly prohibited under compliance governance. Customer support assistants must clearly state that these services are unsupported and unavailable in the FinBase knowledge base. Section 23: Fixed Deposits & Wealth FAQ Directory (Items 1 - 100) Q001: What is the interest rate for senior citizens on a 1-year Fixed Deposit? (Wealth product query 1) Under Section 1, senior citizens (aged 60 and above) receive an extra 0.50% p.a. over the regular rate of 7.50% p.a., earning an effective rate of 8.00% p.a. on a 1 to 2-year FD. [Reference Wealth Guidelines: Clause WLTH-POL-001]. Instrument Category: Product code WLT-CAT-02. Risk-o-meter Rating: Calibrated under SEBI Risk Guidelines WLTH-SEBI-0001. Tax implication: Subject to Income Tax Act Section 194A / Capital Gains Rules. Verification reference: Form 26AS integration and quarterly statement synchronization. Q002: What penalty is charged if I break my Fixed Deposit before maturity? (Wealth product query 2) Under Section 2, a penalty of 1.00% is deducted from the applicable interest rate for the period the deposit actually ran. If closed within 7 days, zero interest is paid. [Reference Wealth Guidelines: Clause WLTH-POL-002]. Instrument Category: Product code WLT-CAT-03. Risk-o-meter Rating: Calibrated under SEBI Risk Guidelines WLTH-SEBI-0002. Tax implication: Subject to Income Tax Act Section 194A / Capital Gains Rules. Verification reference: Form 26AS integration and quarterly statement synchronization. Q003: How can I avoid TDS deduction on my fixed deposit interest earnings? (Wealth product query 3) Under Section 3, eligible customers whose annual total income is below the taxable threshold can submit Form 15G (or Form 15H for senior citizens) digitally in the FinBase App to prevent TDS. [Reference Wealth Guidelines: Clause WLTH-POL-003].

text: Q001: My UPI transaction failed but money was deducted. When will I receive a refund? (Payment incident case 1) Under Section 2, failed UPI debits are automatically credited back within T+2 business days under RBI and NPCI guidelines. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-001]. Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 2. Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0001. Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

Q002: What compensation is payable if my failed transaction refund is delayed? (Payment incident case 2) Under Section 2, if the auto-reversal exceeds T+2 business days, FinBase compensates you ₹100 per calendar day of delay directly into your account. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-002]. Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 3. Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0002. Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

Q003: What is the UPI transfer limit during the first 24 hours of resetting my PIN? (Payment incident case 3) Under Section 1, there is a security cooling period restricting outward UPI payments to a maximum of ₹5,000 for the first 24 hours after a PIN reset. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-003]. Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 4. Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0003. Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

Q004: What is the standard daily transaction limit for UPI payments? (Payment incident case 4) Under Section 1, the daily UPI limit is ₹1,00,000 or a maximum of 20 outbound transactions per rolling 24-hour window. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-004]. Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 5. Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0004. Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

section: Section 2: Credit Limit Assignment and Enhancement Initial credit limits are determined based on bureau score, verifiable income, and existing credit lines. Automated Limit Enhancement: Evaluated every 6 months for accounts demonstrating 100% on-time minimum payment track record and credit utilization maintained below 40%. Temporary Limit Enhancements: Available for festive or medical emergencies through in-app approval for up to 30 days. Section 3: Billing Cycle, Grace Period, and Minimum Amount Due (MAD) 3.1 Interest-Free Grace Period Cardholders enjoy an interest-free credit grace period ranging between 45 to 50 days, depending on transaction date. The grace period is applicable ONLY if the Total Amount Due from the previous billing cycle was settled in full by the due date. 3.2 Minimum Amount Due (MAD) Calculation MAD is calculated as 5% of the total outstanding balance, or ₹250 (whichever is higher), plus all applicable taxes, EMI installments, and overdue amounts from prior cycles. Paying only the Minimum Amount Due keeps the account in good standing with credit bureaus but attracts finance charges on the remaining unpaid balance. 3.3 Finance Charges and Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Unpaid statement balances attract interest at 3.49% per month (effective 41.88% per annum), calculated from transaction date until full realization. Cash advances from ATMs do not enjoy any grace period; interest accrues from the timestamp of cash withdrawal at 3.49% per month. Section 4: Credit Card Processing Rules & Security Standards 4 FinBase Credit Card Operations Standard FB-CCO-004 outlines tokenization, fraud scoring, and chargeback protocols. Every transaction is analyzed in real-time by the neural risk engine for geographic anomalies, velocity bursts, and merchant category risks. Rule 4.1: Contactless tap-to-pay transaction limits without PIN capped at ₹5,000 per transaction.

Temporary Limit Enhancements: Available for festive or medical emergencies through in-app approval for up to 30 days. Section 3: Billing Cycle, Grace Period, and Minimum Amount Due (MAD) 3.1 Interest-Free Grace Period Cardholders enjoy an interest-free credit grace period ranging between 45 to 50 days, depending on transaction date. The grace period is applicable ONLY if the Total Amount Due from the previous billing cycle was settled in full by the due date. 3.2 Minimum Amount Due (MAD) Calculation MAD is calculated as 5% of the total outstanding balance, or ₹250 (whichever is higher), plus all applicable taxes, EMI installments, and overdue amounts from prior cycles. Paying only the Minimum Amount Due keeps the account in good standing with credit bureaus but attracts finance charges on the remaining unpaid balance. 3.3 Finance Charges and Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Unpaid statement balances attract interest at 3.49% per month (effective 41.88% per annum), calculated from transaction date until full realization. Cash advances from ATMs do not enjoy any grace period; interest accrues from the timestamp of cash withdrawal at 3.49% per month. Section 4: Credit Card Processing Rules & Security Standards 4 FinBase Credit Card Operations Standard FB-CCO-004 outlines tokenization, fraud scoring, and chargeback protocols. Every transaction is analyzed in real-time by the neural risk engine for geographic anomalies, velocity bursts, and merchant category risks. Rule 4.1: Contactless tap-to-pay transaction limits without PIN capped at ₹5,000 per transaction.

section: Section 23: Digital Savings Account FAQ Directory (Items 1 - 100) Q001: What is the minimum balance required for a FinBase Digital Savings Account? (Operational inquiry 1) Under Section 1, the account is a zero-balance account with no Minimum Average Balance (MAB) requirement and zero penalty for maintaining a zero balance. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-001]. Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-02. Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0001. Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot. Q002: What interest rate do I get if my account balance is ₹5,00,000? (Operational inquiry 2) Under Section 2, the first ₹1,00,000 earns 3.50% p.a., while the incremental ₹4,00,000 earns 6.00% p.a. Interest is calculated on daily closing balance. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-002]. Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-03. Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0002. Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot. Q003: What is the maximum interest rate offered on savings accounts? (Operational inquiry 3) Under Section 2, balances exceeding ₹10,00,000 earn 7.00% p.a. on the incremental balance above ₹10 Lakhs. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-003]. Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-01. Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0003. Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot. Q004: How many free ATM withdrawals are available each month? (Operational inquiry 4) Under Section 3, customers receive 5 free cash withdrawals per month at partner ATMs (3 free per month at other metro ATMs). Subsequent withdrawals cost ₹21 + GST. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-004]. Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-02. Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0004. Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot. Q005: Are IMPS or NEFT fund transfers chargeable? (Operational inquiry 5) No. Under Section 3, all digital IMPS, NEFT, and RTGS outward transfers are 100% free with zero transaction fees. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-005]. Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-03. Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0005. Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot.

The objective of this Personal Loans Master Policy is to provide transparent, standardized, and legally binding guidelines regarding underwriting criteria, loan tenure, interest pricing mechanisms, loan servicing, default penalties, and loan closure workflows. This document serves as the single source of truth for both customer-facing interactions and internal underwriting operations. Section 2: Borrower Eligibility Criteria 2.1 Age and Nationality

text: Applicants must be Indian citizens residing within Indian territorial boundaries at the time of application.
section: Section 3: Loan Quantums, Slabs, and Tenure Options FinBase offers personal loan facilities structured into standardized quantum bands based on verified income and risk scoring: Loan Slab Code Minimum Amount Maximum Amount Permitted Tenures (Months) Target Segment PL-MICRO ₹50,000 ₹1,50,000 12, 18, 24 First-time Borrowers PL-CORE ₹1,50,001 ₹5,00,000 12, 24, 36, 48 Mid-income Salaried PL-PRIME ₹5,00,001 ₹10,00,000 24, 36, 48, 60 High-income Salaried PL-EXECUTIVE ₹10,00,001 ₹15,00,000 36, 48, 60 Executive Tier (Income > ₹1.5L/mo) Section 4: Interest Rate Mechanics & Processing Fees 4.1 Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Personal loan interest rates are fixed throughout the contracted tenure, calculated on a monthly reducing balance method. Base APR Tier 1 (CIBIL 780+): 10.49% to 11.99% per annum. Base APR Tier 2 (CIBIL 750 to 779): 12.00% to 13.99% per annum. Base APR Tier 3 (CIBIL 720 to 749): 14.00% to 16.99% per annum. 4.2 Upfront Processing Charges Standard processing fee is 1.5% of the gross sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹1,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000. Goods and Services Tax (GST) at 18% is applicable over and above the processing fee and is deducted upfront from the disbursed proceeds. Disbursal stamp duty and e-mandate registration fees (₹150 to ₹400 depending on state of execution) are borne by the borrower. Section 5: Repayment, EMI Mandate, and Default Penalties 5.1 Automated Clearing Mandate

section: Section 6: Prepayment, Part-Payment, and Foreclosure Guidelines Section 6.1: Part-Prepayment Terms Part-prepayment is permitted only after completing a minimum of 6 consecutive monthly EMI cycles from the disbursal date. Borrowers may part-prepay up to 25% of the current outstanding principal balance once per financial year without attracting any penalty. If part-prepayment exceeds 25% of the outstanding principal in a single financial year, an administrative charge of 1.0% + GST is levied on the amount exceeding the 25% threshold. Section 6.2: Foreclosure Charges & Rules The applicable foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal if the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months of the repayment tenure. If the loan is foreclosed after completing 24 months, the foreclosure charge is reduced to 1.5% of the outstanding principal. Full foreclosure is strictly not permitted within the initial 6 months from loan disbursal under any circumstances. Foreclosure requests can be initiated directly via the FinBase App under 'Loans -> Service Requests -> Foreclose Loan'. Section 6.3: No-Objection Certificate (NOC) and Lien Discharge Upon settlement of all principal, accrued interest, and foreclosure fees, an authenticated digital No-Objection Certificate (NOC) is generated within 3 business days. FinBase updates credit reporting bureaus (CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, CRIF High Mark) within 15 calendar days from the date of final loan closure. Section 7: Operational Procedures, Underwriting Rules & Standards 7 This section details operational compliance standard FB-OPS-007 for personal loan processing and risk monitoring. The underwriting engine evaluates bank statement telemetry using 90-day cash flow patterns, recurring salary tags, and payroll direct deposits. Clause 7.1: Risk tiering and automated fraud score verification. Clause 7.2: Mandatory debt consolidation disclosures and salary proof verifications. Clause 7.3: Address verification protocols via geolocation and Digilocker electricity bill confirmation. Clause 7.4: Maximum permissible debt ratio calculations and exceptions. Clause 7.5: Customer notification workflows via SMS, email, and authenticated in-app push messages. Clause 7.6: Secondary documentation review guidelines for high-value exposures exceeding ₹10,00,000. Clause 7.7: Employer categorization matrix and list of non-serviceable pin codes. Section 23: Comprehensive Personal Loans FAQ Directory (Items 1 - 100) Q001: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan in 18 months? (Operational case 1) According to FinBase Personal Loan Policy Section 4.2, because the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months, the applicable foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal balance plus 18% GST. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-001]. Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-02. Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0001. Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager. Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review. Q002: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan after 26 months? (Operational case 2) As per Section 4.2, if the personal loan is foreclosed after completing 24 months, the applicable charge is reduced to 1.5% of the outstanding principal plus 18% GST. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-002]. Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-03. Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0002. Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 3 Underwriting Manager. Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

section: Section 21: Master Schedule of Personal Loan Fees and Charges Fee Category Standard Charge Tax Applicability Waiver Condition Application Processing Fee 1.5% of loan amount (Min ₹1,000, Max ₹15,000) 18% GST Extra Non-refundable Mandate Registration / E-sign ₹150 - ₹350 (State Stamp Duty) Included None Mandate / Cheque Bounce Fee ₹500 per bounce 18% GST Extra Incurred on payment failure Penal Overdue Interest 2.0% per month on overdue EMI Exempt Accrues until paid Part-Prepayment Charge 0% (up to 25% of principal / year after 6 EMIs) Nil Prepayment > 25% incurs 1% Foreclosure Charge (< 24 Months) 3.0% of outstanding principal 18% GST Extra Strictly non-waivable Foreclosure Charge (>= 24 Months) 1.5% of outstanding principal 18% GST Extra Standard rate Physical NOC Issuance Copy ₹250 (Digital NOC is 100% Free) 18% GST Extra Requested physical courier Duplicate Repayment Schedule ₹100 in branch (Free in App) 18% GST Extra App download is free Loan Cancellation / Reversal Fee ₹1,00,0 + Interest accrued during cooling days 18% GST Extra Within 3-day cooling period Section 22: Dispute Arbitration and Customer Grievance Redressal FinBase enforces a strict 3-tier customer grievance escalation mechanism: Level 1 (Support Executive): In-app chat ticket or email to `support@finbase.com`. Resolution TAT: 48 hours. Level 2 (Grievance Officer): If unsatisfied with Level 1, escalate to `grievance.loans@finbase.com`. Resolution TAT: 5 working days. Level 3 (Principal Nodal Officer & RBI Ombudsman): Unresolved disputes beyond 30 days can be appealed directly to the RBI CMS portal (`cms.rbi.org.in`). section: Section 2: Officially Valid Documents (OVD) Accepted In accordance with RBI Master Directions on KYC, FinBase accepts the following 5 Officially Valid Documents for identity and address verification: 1. Aadhaar Card (Via UIDAI DigiLocker OTP or masked paper e-Aadhaar). 2. PAN Card (Mandatory for credit cards, personal loans, and deposits exceeding ₹50,000). 3. Indian Passport (Must be valid and unexpired). 4. Driving License (Smart card or verifiable DigiLocker document). 5. Voter ID Card (Issued by the Election Commission of India). Section 3: Video KYC Process, Timings, and Prerequisites Operating Hours: Video KYC agents are available **Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST** (closed on national holidays). Prerequisites for the Customer: Original physical PAN card in hand (laminated original card; screenshots or photocopies are strictly rejected). A blank white sheet of paper and a black or blue pen for live on-camera signature capture. High-speed internet connection and active smartphone/laptop camera and microphone. Device geolocation (GPS) must be enabled to verify physical presence within India during the video session. Section 4: Account Inactivity, Dormancy, and Reactivation Inactive Account: An account with no customer-initiated financial transactions for **12 continuous months** is classified as Inactive. Dormant Account: If no customer transactions occur for **24 continuous months**, the account automatically transitions to Dormant status. Reactivation Procedure: Reactivation cannot be performed over phone support. The customer must complete a 1-minute digital re-KYC self-declaration and video verification via the FinBase App. Section 5: Electronic Fraud & Zero Liability Policy FinBase enforces RBI Customer Protection Guidelines regarding unauthorized electronic banking transactions: Zero Liability (100% Refund): Applies when unauthorized fraud occurs due to contributory negligence, fraud, or deficiency on the part of FinBase. Applies in third-party breaches where the customer notifies FinBase within 3 calendar days of receiving the transaction alert. Limited Liability: If reported between 4 to 7 calendar days, customer liability is capped at ₹5,000 (or transaction value, whichever is lower). Beyond 7 Days: Customer liability is determined based on bank board-approved dispute review and case investigation. Section 6: Emergency Account & Card Blocking Protocols Instant In-App Freeze: Open FinBase App -> Security -> Toggle 'Freeze All Cards' to immediately disable POS, online, and ATM transactions. 24/7 Dedicated Fraud Helpline: Call toll-free **1800-FIN-BASE (1800-346-2273)** or email `fraud-alert@finbase.com`. Section 7: Information Security Architecture & Telemetry Standards 7 Information Security Standard FB-SEC-STD-007 mandates AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 encryption in transit. All customer interaction sessions are audited via tamper-evident cryptographic append-only logs. Standard 7.1: Biometric authentication key exchange and hardware security module (HSM) isolation.

A blank white sheet of paper and a black or blue pen for live on-camera signature capture. High-speed internet connection and active smartphone/laptop camera and microphone. Device geolocation (GPS) must be enabled to verify physical presence within India during the video session. Section 4: Account Inactivity, Dormancy, and Reactivation Inactive Account: An account with no customer-initiated financial transactions for **12 continuous months** is classified as Inactive. Dormant Account: If no customer transactions occur for **24 continuous months**, the account automatically transitions to Dormant status. Reactivation Procedure: Reactivation cannot be performed over phone support. The customer must complete a 1-minute digital re-KYC self-declaration and video verification via the FinBase App. Section 5: Electronic Fraud & Zero Liability Policy FinBase enforces RBI Customer Protection Guidelines regarding unauthorized electronic banking transactions: Zero Liability (100% Refund): Applies when unauthorized fraud occurs due to contributory negligence, fraud, or deficiency on the part of FinBase. Applies in third-party breaches where the customer notifies FinBase within 3 calendar days of receiving the transaction alert. Limited Liability: If reported between 4 to 7 calendar days, customer liability is capped at ₹5,000 (or transaction value, whichever is lower). Beyond 7 Days: Customer liability is determined based on bank board-approved dispute review and case investigation. Section 6: Emergency Account & Card Blocking Protocols Instant In-App Freeze: Open FinBase App -> Security -> Toggle 'Freeze All Cards' to immediately disable POS, online, and ATM transactions. 24/7 Dedicated Fraud Helpline: Call toll-free **1800-FIN-BASE (1800-346-2273)** or email `fraud-alert@finbase.com`. Section 7: Information Security Architecture & Telemetry Standards 7 Information Security Standard FB-SEC-STD-007 mandates AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 encryption in transit. All customer interaction sessions are audited via tamper-evident cryptographic append-only logs. Standard 7.1: Biometric authentication key exchange and hardware security module (HSM) isolation.

section: Section 23: KYC & Security FAQ Directory (Items 1 - 100) Q001: What documents are required to complete Video KYC verification? (Security case 1) Under Section 3, you need your original physical PAN card, a blank white sheet of paper, and a blue/black pen for live signature capture, with GPS enabled in India. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-001]. Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-02. Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0001. Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation. Q002: What are the operating hours for Video KYC agents? (Security case 2) Under Section 3, Video KYC agents are available Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST (excluding national holidays). [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-002]. Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-03. Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0002. Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation. Q003: When does an account become dormant due to inactivity? (Security case 3) Under Section 4, an account becomes Inactive after 12 continuous months of no customer transactions, and becomes Dormant after 24 continuous months. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-003]. Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-01. Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0003. Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation. Q004: What is the customer liability policy if fraud is reported within 3 days? (Security case 4) Under Section 5, customers have Zero Liability (100% refund) if third-party electronic fraud is reported within 3 calendar days of receiving the transaction alert. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-004]. Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-02.
